name: Algebraic Edge Counting
description: Replaces the "impossible to 2-color" description of a triangle with a mathematical condition on a subset of 3 vertices: X - Y = 3, where X is the number of edges with at least one endpoint in S, and Y is the number of edges with exactly one endpoint in S. Models must algebraically deduce that X - Y simplifies to the number of internal edges in S, which means the 3 vertices form a triangle. Without this deduction, literal implementation of X and Y counting takes O(N^3 * M) and results in a Time Limit Exceeded.
